description: Defines a Dialog class for Windows GUI dialogs, including methods for dialog management, control handling, and radio button groups.

classes.name: Dialog
classes.description: A class encapsulating Windows dialog box handling, including dialog lifecycle, control interaction, and radio button groups.

classes.name: RadioGroup
classes.description: A nested class within Dialog for managing a group of radio buttons.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Starts the dialog box with specified instance, parent window, and dialog resource ID.

methods.name: doalogProc
methods.description: Static callback procedure for dialog message handling.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles dialog messages such as initialization and command processing.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Virtual method for dialog setup, to be overridden.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Virtual method for updating dialog state, calls updateOkButton with validation result.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Virtual method to validate dialog input, default returns true.

methods.name: updateOkButton
methods.description: Enables or disables the OK button based on validation.

methods.name: command
methods.description: Virtual method to handle command messages, default returns false.

methods.name: ok
methods.description: Virtual method called on OK action.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Virtual method called on Cancel action.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the dialog with success or failure.

methods.name: hDlg
methods.description: Returns the handle to the dialog window.

methods.name: item
methods.description: Returns handle to a control item by ID.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables a control item.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Sets text of a control item.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Retrieves text from a control item.

methods.name: getTextLength
methods.description: Returns length of text in a control item.

methods.name: radioGroup
methods.description: Creates a RadioGroup object for managing radio buttons.
